title: Biomimetic stress granules replenish lysosomal repair to reinstate macrophage immunometabolic antibacterial programs.
snippet: Severe intracellular bacterial infection can progressively compromise lysosomal defence in macrophages, yet the underlying repair bottleneck remains unclear.
